name: Sagimori Itsuma
source:
A second year university student from Kansai. He speaks in the Osaka dialect.
He used to be the protagonist's classmate in high school before she reinvented herself.
He works as a popular comedian under the name Matsui, but in real life he acts cool and distant.
He's actually shy and doesn't feel comfortable around flashy girls.
